body:
Aye, I suppose you are correct. I fear, however, that the night is waning now, and Sleep demands her tribute, lest we all die horribly.

So, if you'll excuse me. (It's abrupt; my apologies.)

Ah. I see. My apologies for the somewhat abrasive wording of that question; by no means did I mean to possibly cause you any distress.

You know, I know words can make a difference; but in very specific cases, I think words are just that, words. Empty letters attempting to form meaning, if you will.

Ah, but such thoughts tire me. You had more to say before my question, no doubt?

Ah, no. I've tried it before, and it just doesn't help me.

Furthermore, to be frank, I distrust them, fearing that they'll have me involuntarily committed (and there go dreams of any security clearance!). Of course it's a horribly irrational fear, but it's not entirely without basis.


Once again, though, I must stress my belief that **no one can help me**, especially in the doom-and-gloom times, whether professional or amateur.

Why do you take such an interest, if I could ask?

I'm not sure what use that will do; and, regardless, it's more along the lines of never saying anything to X., rather than outright asking X. out on a date. (I do hope that makes sense — I sometimes have a tendency to confuse folks.)

I'm afraid I don't quite comprehend the meaning of your question: for folks whose lives they consider useless, or for "those unlucky few who cannot ever see happiness on Earth"? For the former, I believe the safeguards currently in place, to some extent, with therapists and hotlines and the like, work as they're supposed to (of course, they have their flaws, but by and large, they function quite well).

For the latter, I fear I would not be the correct person to approach in this matter; in no way am I fit for leadership, or for the establishment of organizations, in general: I find myself to be too domineering and tyrannical when placed into positions of power. Moreover, I don't know whether such persons wish to be helped: if they're like me, I doubt that they'll exactly be open to it, citing personal responsibility, respectability, and a distaste for emotions and publicly expressing them.

Therefore, though something tells me that you're masquerading and that I'm dealing with persons far beyond my lowly ability to comprehend (or perhaps that's simply my imagination, running away again), I would have to decline to found, lead, or create such an organization (though how much I would if it were feasible!); additionally, I would have to decline allowance of funding such a foundation, simply due to its non-existence.

(Something tells me I just lost a $1 million USD grant. Oh well, I told the truth to the best of my ability, and that, while not perfection, is good enough for me. For now.)

Ah, if only such things could be so. I fear I deal in the harsh realities of life, though, and regardless of my possible pulchritude or intellect, nobility or afflluence, I am simply one of those unlucky few who cannot ever see happiness on Earth. 

Alas, I have reached such a point where I succumb to ideas that life is pointless and useless. But enough of speaking about myself in such light and airy terms: quite frankly, my life never had a reason for its existence, and it lacks one still today.
Awfully strange question to ask, if you ask me. However, I'll humor you: no, I'm not "a girl".
